description: This file defines the Cart controller class within the OpenCart system, specifically under the namespace for checkout operations. It contains methods for displaying the cart, listing cart contents, getting cart data as a JSON response, and adding products to the cart, along with managing vouchers, totals, and other cart-related functionality.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class for managing the shopping cart, including displaying cart contents, adding items, and processing cart-related operations within the checkout process.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main shopping cart page with current items, totals, and checkout options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of cart items in a view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns cart data as a JSON string, including cart items, vouchers, totals, and other details.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a product to the cart via POST request, including options, quantity, subscription plan, and related cart data.
